title: Michael Nsiah-Nimo
text:
I am a research statistician and data analytics professional with seven years of experience turning complex data into evidence that informs research and decision-making. My work sits at the intersection of rigorous statistical methodology and practical analytics, with a particular focus on health disparities research.
On the research side, I use R and Python to build statistical models and analyze biomedical and clinical data. My methodological toolkit includes survival analysis, causal inference, general and generalized linear models, and linear mixed models.
On the analytics side, I work with SQL, Tableau, and CRM systems to prepare, analyze, and visualize higher education and research data, delivering both descriptive and predictive analytics that help institutions understand trends and plan ahead.
I hold an MS in Statistics and am pursuing a PhD in Biostatistics at the University of Nebraska Medical Center.
